title: Camera removal not detected after toggling monitoring_feeds on Linux
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5beta3


### System information

Godot v4.5.beta3 - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - D3D12 (AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics) - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 30.19 GiB memory

### Issue description

On Linux, when `CameraServer.monitoring_feeds` is disabled and then re-enabled, the camera monitoring thread stops detecting device removal. USB cameras that are physically disconnected continue to appear in the feeds list.

This occurs because the `exit_flag` is not cleared when re-enabling monitoring in `CameraLinux::set_monitoring_feeds(true)`, preventing the monitoring thread from running properly after being restarted.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the MRP
2. Follow the console messages to connect and disconnect the USB camera

Expected console output:

```
=== Camera Hot-Plug Test ===
Testing camera detection and removal behavior


--- Test: Camera hot-plug detection after toggling monitoring ---
This test checks if cameras can be detected/removed after disabling and re-enabling monitoring
Please connect a USB camera and wait...
✓ Started camera monitoring
Camera(s) detected: 1
✓ Stopped camera monitoring
✓ Restarted camera monitoring

Please disconnect the camera now...
Expected behavior: Camera should be removed from the list
Actual result: 0 camera(s) still in the list
✓ TEST PASSED: Camera removal detected correctly

=== Test Complete ===
```

Actual console output:

```
=== Camera Hot-Plug Test ===
Testing camera detection and removal behavior


--- Test: Camera hot-plug detection after toggling monitoring ---
This test checks if cameras can be detected/removed after disabling and re-enabling monitoring
Please connect a USB camera and wait...
✓ Started camera monitoring
Camera(s) detected: 1
✓ Stopped camera monitoring
✓ Restarted camera monitoring

Please disconnect the camera now...
Expected behavior: Camera should be removed from the list
Actual result: 1 camera(s) still in the list
✗ TEST FAILED: Camera removal not detected
   After restarting monitoring, the system cannot detect when cameras are unplugged

=== Test Complete ===
```

Note: This issue can also be reproduced on Windows using WSL + [usbipd](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/connect-usb)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[linux-camera.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21205446/linux-camera.zip)
